name: Gouriki Norio
source:
He is a second-year student like the main character, and has a bold and daring atmosphere. He looks like a fin-de-siècle champion, and his intimidating aura overwhelms everyone who sees him.

He and the protagonist hit it off during an encounter at a certain event, and they quickly became best friends. Although his appearance may not suggest it, he is in fact a genuine 2-dimensional otaku. He is more of a follower than an otaku, and has no interest in the three-dimensional (real) world.

Recently, he loves a life-size figure as his wife. He also shows interest in real girls as well. He also runs a mysterious club called the “Dark Martial Arts Club” on campus by himself. According to him, he is the defending champion of the world tournament.

As a side note, he is a man among men who wears moe T-shirts in his casual clothes. The moe character stretching out with his strong pectoral muscles is even somewhat melancholic.

[From [url=http://rootnuko.jp/products/tenioha2_web/character.html]official site[/url]]
